name: zero-debt-gate
description: Automated quality gate verification and remediation loop enforcing zero debt across formatters, linters, static type checkers, and test suites.

steps.prompt: Create the directory {{run_dir}} if it does not exist using mkdir -p. Emit the absolute directory path as your final output.

Run formatting checks, linters, static type checks, and test suites covering {{target_dir}}. If all checks pass cleanly with zero warnings and zero errors, write {"passed": true} to {{run_dir}}/gate.json and call send_message with severity 'success' summarizing clean verification. If any check fails, fix the root causes without disabling linter rules or skipping tests, record failures in {{run_dir}}/gate.json as {"passed": false}, and complete this iteration so the stop condition can evaluate gate.json.
